# Orebfuscator

**Category:** Exploit  
**Aliases:** Orebfuscator

## What it does

Attempts to de-obfuscate ores that obfuscated by a plugin.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://www.futureclient.net/#features). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
